what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A brief for a factory that deploys SG/Send and sgit servers from a request file, in any account and region.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: A server factory, request in and server out, four shapes, one bootstrap stack, GitHub for the factory, phases.

sections.label: Why a factory
sections.line: Vaults need servers in the owner's account and region; the image, templates and OIDC pattern exist.

sections.label: The name
sections.line: The SGit Server Factory, with its agent factory.server; sgit-deploy stays the Action.

sections.label: The request
sections.line: A server.json per request: account, region, shape, storage, time to live, owner; the token sealed, never stored.

sections.label: Four shapes
sections.line: Ephemeral Lambda in memory, Lambda on S3, an EC2 appliance, Fargate: one image, one smoke test.

sections.label: The pipeline
sections.line: Validate, check, copy the image, deploy, prove with a vault push and clone, record, tear down.

sections.label: Any account
sections.line: One bootstrap stack per account, a StackSet or a Terraform module, then one line in accounts.json.

sections.label: Any region
sections.line: Everything derives from account and region; the image copied on first use; one us-east-1 caveat.

sections.label: Does it need GitHub?
sections.line: The factory is a repository and trusted through OIDC; servers need no repository of their own.

sections.label: The phases
sections.line: Our account first, then ephemeral, regions, a second account, customers, the Action and skill.

sections.label: The brief for the agent
sections.line: The brief for factory.server: goal, what to read, the rules, and phase 1 to start.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A brief, not built; beta templates; formats to settle.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: My brief and the SG/Send deploy templates, read on 21 November.
